# Captured source metadata

bitcoin-metadata.json contains historical Blockstream metadata and Bitcoin header controls captured on October 4, 2026. Recovery tests use these supplied responses offline; the file is not a product lookup receipt or a fresh provider observation.

The JSON bytes are unchanged from the original capture, including its historical type, scope and accounting fields. SHA256: 53c4b54fbb1e2a585bda5c048cf80febb2270e98caaff3175e6c281110e3a655.

The product test checks supplied header identities, proof-of-work targets, timestamp linkage and median calculations. Those checks do not independently validate the full Bitcoin chain.
